column8: RETAINED, NOT PREFERRED. Table 3's energy is HDIP's tonnage times a conversion held constant at 18.73 TJ/Gg across FY2015-16..FY2020-21 to 0.016 per cent while the fleet went from imported bituminous to 92 per cent Thar lignite, then breaking upward as the fleet's physical calorific value fell. Divided into NEPRA's own printed generation it implies net fleet efficiencies inside 28-47 per cent in TWO of nine years against the booked account's NINE of nine. It is kept as a named control because a reader holding a total published before the re-base is entitled to find the account it came from, and because retaining a refuted control beside the reference is a weaker claim than deleting it. It is NOT equally probable with the reference
